 Order

The petitioner who is the resident of Udupi District has called in question the correctness of the award passed under Section 3-G of the National Highways Act, 1956 ("the Act", for short) and Section 29 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 dated 10.12.2020 and have also sought for direction in the nature of writ of mandamus to the first respondent to decide strictly in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2.

Special Land Acquisition Officer and Another and the Competent Authority NH169(13), wherein the National Highway Authorities have challenged the first award under Section 3-G (5) of the Act has been disposed off.

sentences.text:
The dispute involved in the present petition with regard to quantum of NC:
2023:KHC:20446 compensation payable to the petitioners as well as the legality,
validity and correctness of the impugned awards are hereby referred to the Deputy Commissioner/ Statutory Arbitrator before whom, the petitions filed by the respondents challenging the first / original awards passed by the respondents which were subject matter of Valerial Sequeria's case (supra) are pending adjudication for disposal in accordance with law.
It is submitted that the present matter can also be disposed off in terms of the order in W.P.No.13658/2021 dated 13.02.2023 on the principle of parity.

6. The learned counsel for the respondent authorities submit that the matter may be disposed off in terms of the directions of the Coordinate Bench passed in identical factual matrix including in W.P.No.13658/2021 dated 13.02.2023.

7. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The petition is disposed off on same terms in W.P.No.13658/2021 dated 13.02.2023.

3 ii)

sentences.text:
The dispute involved in the petition with regard to quantum of compensation,
legality, validity and correctness of the award are referred to the Deputy Commissioner/Statutory Authority.
The Deputy Commissioner/Statutory Authority is directed to decide the present grievance raised in the writ petition and dispose off the same in accordance with law.
iv) Liberty is reserved in favour of the petitioner to file pleadings and documents before the Deputy Commissioner/ Statutory Authority pursuant to this award.

v) All rival contentions are kept open and no opinion is expressed on the same.
vi) The Deputy Commissioner/Statutory Authority is directed to dispose off the proceedings expeditiously.

vii) It is made clear that the order is restricted to the petitioner's grievance only and is made in the peculiar/special facts and circumstances of the instant case and shall not be treated as a precedent and is passed taking note of the directions on similarly situated land losers in W.P.No.13658/2021.

viii) Petitioner to file a petition containing the grounds as made out in the present petition along with the NC: 2023:KHC:20446 copy of the present writ petition within three weeks from today before the Deputy Commissioner/Statutory Authority.
